:::{#about}

::: {.lead-role}
Postdoctoral researcher · Helmholtz-Zentrum Hereon
:::

I am a postdoctoral researcher at the [Institute of Material Systems Modeling](https://www.hereon.de/institutes/material_systems_modeling/index.php.en) of the [Helmholtz-Zentrum Hereon](https://www.hereon.de) (Hamburg area, Germany), working in **computational mechanics**.

I completed my PhD in Computational Mechanics at [Université Paris-Saclay](https://www.universite-paris-saclay.fr) in July 2026, at the [Laboratoire de Mécanique Paris-Saclay](https://lmps.ens-paris-saclay.fr) (LMPS), under the supervision of Bing Tie and Andrea Barbarulo. My thesis developed **hyperelastic reduced-order models** based on the **Proper Generalised Decomposition (PGD)**, for biomimetic material applications such as 3D printing patient-specific aneurysmal aortic models.
